gold: Cranial nerve 7 (CN7) paresis secondary to acute bacterial sinusitis

selector.rationale: The patient's presentation with right-sided chemosis, exophthalmos, and purulent nasal secretions, along with CT scan findings of an orbital abscess extending from right-sided rhinosinusitis, strongly supports Rhinosinusitis as the champion diagnosis.

rejected.label: Cavernous sinus syndrome
rejected.why: Lack of specific findings to support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Cavernous sinus thrombosis
rejected.why: No evidence of thrombosis on imaging studies

rejected.label: Coagulase-negative Staphylococcus aureus infection
rejected.why: While cultures grew this organism, the clinical presentation is more consistent with Rhinosinusitis
